database_path.label: Timewarrior database path
database_path.description: Directory containing Timewarrior's data files. Leave empty to use TIMEWARRIORDB or ~/.config/timewarrior.

poll_interval.label: Poll interval (seconds)
poll_interval.description: How often to refresh the tracked duration and week/month/year totals.

overtime_hours.label: Overtime threshold (hours)
overtime_hours.description: Hours above which a tracked duration switches to the overtime color, in the bar and in the panel's per-day totals.

start_command.label: Start command
start_command.description: Shell command run by the panel's start button. Leave empty to run `timew start`. Runs with TIMEWARRIORDB set, e.g. `~/bin/zhj tw::work-start`.

stop_command.label: Stop command
stop_command.description: Shell command run by the panel's stop button. Leave empty to run `timew stop`.

command_timeout.label: Command timeout (seconds)
command_timeout.description: How long to wait for the start/stop command before giving up. Wrappers that sync or shut things down can take a while.

panel_time_format.label: Panel time format
panel_time_format.description: Format of the panel's week/month/year/day totals. Placeholders: {hours}, {minutes}.

bar_time_format.label: Bar time format
bar_time_format.description: Format of the tracked duration shown in the bar. Placeholders: {hours}, {minutes}.

label_color.label: Label color
label_color.description: Duration text color while under the overtime threshold, in the bar and in the panel's per-day totals.

label_overtime_color.label: Label overtime color
label_overtime_color.description: Duration text color once a tracked duration passes the overtime threshold, in the bar and in the panel's per-day totals.

icon_size.label: Icon size
icon_size.description: Bar display size of the Timewarrior logo, in pixels.

breakdown_days.label: Breakdown days
breakdown_days.description: How many days, ending today, the panel's day breakdown lists. Each day can be clicked to inspect and edit its intervals.

interval_precision.label: Interval time precision
interval_precision.description: How today's interval start and end times are shown, and the precision an edit of one defaults to.

visibility.label: Show in the bar
visibility.description: When the widget occupies its bar slot while nothing is tracked. A running interval is always shown.
